verdict.rationale: Radar lets you tailor outcomes to your business: custom rules can be built on supported attributes and value lists, trusted-customer lists auto-allow payments, and risk settings adjust thresholds. Radar Sessions captures fraud signals such as device data, but that data is collected by Stripe rather than supplied by you, and nothing shows your own fingerprints, behavioral data or metadata feeding the ML score itself. A community report also cites a lack of easy programmatic control. Missing for 10: documented ingestion of merchant-supplied device fingerprints or behavioral signals into model scoring, custom metadata used as model features rather than just rule inputs, and hands-on corroboration of custom-signal influence on scores.
